company.name: ClearGrid
company.shortDescription: Cleargrid is a fintech platform providing credit infrastructure, risk assessment, and debt collection solutions for businesses.
company.description: Cleargrid is a fintech infrastructure platform that helps businesses manage credit underwriting, risk assessment, and debt collection. It uses data analytics and AI-driven insights to evaluate borrower reliability, automate credit decisions, and improve recovery processes. The platform enables lenders to reduce defaults, enhance efficiency, and scale credit operations securely and intelligently.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $3,500,000, or 29.17% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,367,767 to $43,205,064, a 3.23x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
